Name: Elliott's Second Chance
Author: Charnoodle101
Description:
Elliott's first book did not live up to expectations - so he's come to Pelican Town to retreat to his cabin, and try to redeem his reputation...

Elliott's Second Chance features an overhaul of all Elliott's vanilla heart events, as well as 5 additional heart events (at 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9 hearts). Elliott also sends you letters in the mail (he's a writer, after all) - and he sends you a special letter after you start dating, and after you get engaged (if you'd like to go the romance route, of course)...! This mod also features slight dialogue tweaks, and a custom letter background for all of Elliott's correspondence!

Mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] and also includes unique dialogue for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32078]Wedding Anniversaries[/url] - check it out! <3

Heart Events - 

[spoiler][b]1 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Museum / Library, between 11 AM and 5 PM (with one free inventory slot)

[b]2 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Elliott's Cabin

[b]3 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Cindersap Forest, between 11 AM and 3 PM, on a sunny day

[b]4 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Saloon, between 3 PM and 10 PM

[b]5 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Pelican Beach, between 10 AM and 2 PM, on a sunny day

[b]6 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Elliott's Cabin

[b]7 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Mountains, between 8 PM and 11 PM, on a sunny day

[b]8 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Museum / Library, between 1 PM and 7 PM, after having received a letter from Elliott

[b]9 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Saloon, between 7 PM and 10 PM, after having received a letter from Elliott (with two free inventory slots)

[b]10 Heart Event[/b]
Requirements: Pelican Beach, between 7 AM and 1 PM, on a sunny day, after having received a letter from Elliott

[b]14 Heart Event - Part One[/b]
Requirements: Farm, between 5 AM and 3 PM

[b]14 Heart Event - Part Two[/b]
Requirements: Farmhouse[/spoiler]
* If you are having trouble triggering an event and are unsure about the conditions required - consider downloading [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39885]MH Event List[/url] for a more detailed breakdown!

I am still quite new to modding, so despite a lot of testing, there may be some errors! If you have any issues, please log a bug report on the mod page and include a [b]SMAPI log[/b] (https://smapi.io/log) and I will try my best to assist!

[b]Note on AI [/b]- no AI has been used to create this mod in any capacity. No AI has been used and no AI will ever be used in my process.

Mods used in screenshots - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37511]Curly Hair Elliott[/url]!
